projection.wire: Complete request body, method, path and authentication/content headers; full final message excluding timestamp/duration; ordered event fields type/contentIndex/delta/content/toolCall/reason. SDK/platform headers and mutable partial snapshots excluded. Loopback HTTP only; no real credentials or model calls.

capabilities.scope: Real HTTP Chat Completions request serialization; streamed text/thinking/tool-call finals, usage, cache costs, stop/error reasons and event order for explicit compatibility options. Partial tool-argument snapshots, retries, OAuth and vendor-specific policies remain gaps.
capabilities.differential: Execute both real adapters against the same loopback HTTP server and fragmented SSE bytes. Compare full request body/path/method/auth, final message and ordered semantic events; omit only platform headers, timestamps, durations and partial snapshots.
